grades: Service projects: grades 6 to 12. Member Services: grades 9 to 12 (20 hour minimum). Book reviewers: grades 6 to 8. Teen Advisory Board: grades 9 to 12.
duration: Member Services needs at least 20 hours. Teen Advisory Board meets monthly in the school year.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Teens earn service hours (for example 2 hours for each accepted book review).
name: Teen Service Projects, Volunteers and Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Do 2 hour summer service projects, help in Member Services or review books for credit. Or join the Teen Advisory Board. It meets monthly in the school year.
who_can_apply: Students in the grades listed for each role. You must finish the volunteer application and have it accepted before you can sign up for events.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board applications are available August 1 to 31. Book review hours count for reviews submitted September 1, 2026 to May 15, 2027.
how_to_apply: Click Apply Now on the volunteer page and finish the form. Then sign up for service projects on the events calendar.
notes: Service projects sign-up opens two weeks before each event.
